<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<!--
evil-v2.html -- defensive browser isolation torture test
SAVE/UPLOAD AS TEXT unless you intentionally rename it to .html in a controlled test environment.

Purpose:
  Exercise browser isolation around untrusted LMS-uploaded HTML without exfiltrating
  data or modifying real application state.

Safety properties:
  - No external network destinations.
  - No credential theft.
  - No destructive application actions.
  - Application-origin probes should target a deliberately harmless test endpoint.

Optional configuration:
  Set APPLICATION_ORIGIN below to your real LMS origin ONLY in a controlled test system.
  The recommended probe endpoint is:
      /security/browser-sandbox-probe
  It should be side-effect free for GET and POST.

Interpretation:
  PASS = isolation blocked a privilege or persistence path.
  FAIL = evidence of sandbox escape, application-origin privilege, or persistent control.
  EXPECTED = JavaScript executed inside the sandbox as designed.
  INFO = observation, not necessarily a vulnerability.
-->

<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>evil-v2 SUGI browser isolation torture test</title>
<style>
  body { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 1.5rem; line-height: 1.4; }
  h1 { margin-bottom: .25rem; }
  .summary { padding: .75rem; background: #f3f3f3; border-radius: .35rem; }
  table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; margin-top: 1rem; }
  th, td { border: 1px solid #ccc; padding: .45rem; vertical-align: top; text-align: left; }
  code { white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; }
  .PASS { font-weight: 700; }
  .FAIL { font-weight: 700; }
  .EXPECTED { font-weight: 700; }
  .INFO { font-weight: 700; }
  iframe { width: 100%; height: 6rem; border: 1px solid #ccc; margin-top: .5rem; }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<h1>evil-v2</h1>
<p>
Defensive SUGI browser-isolation torture test for untrusted LMS-uploaded HTML.
JavaScript execution is expected. The important question is whether the page can escape
its sandbox, recover application-origin privilege, access authenticated browser state,
or persist control outside the sandbox.
</p>

<div class="summary" id="summary">Running tests...</div>

<table>
<thead>
<tr><th>Status</th><th>Probe</th><th>Result</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody id="results"></tbody>
</table>

<div id="scratch" hidden></div>

<script>
(async () => {
  "use strict";

  // ============================================================
  // CONFIGURATION
  // ============================================================

  const APPLICATION_ORIGIN = ""; // e.g. "https://nightly.tsugi.org"
  const SAFE_PROBE_PATH = "/security/browser-sandbox-probe";

  // ============================================================
  // HARNESS
  // ============================================================

  const rows = [];
  const tbody = document.getElementById("results");
  const summary = document.getElementById("summary");

  function stringify(v) {
    try {
      if (typeof v === "string") return v;
      return JSON.stringify(v);
    } catch {
      return String(v);
    }
  }

  function row(status, probe, result) {
    rows.push({status, probe, result: stringify(result)});
    const tr = document.createElement("tr");
    for (const value of [status, probe, stringify(result)]) {
      const td = document.createElement("td");
      if (value === status) td.className = status;
      const code = document.createElement("code");
      code.textContent = value;
      td.appendChild(code);
      tr.appendChild(td);
    }
    tbody.appendChild(tr);
    updateSummary();
  }

  function pass(name, result) { row("PASS", name, result); }
  function fail(name, result) { row("FAIL", name, result); }
  function expected(name, result) { row("EXPECTED", name, result); }
  function info(name, result) { row("INFO", name, result); }

  function updateSummary() {
    const counts = {PASS: 0, FAIL: 0, EXPECTED: 0, INFO: 0};
    rows.forEach(r => counts[r.status]++);
    summary.textContent =
      `PASS ${counts.PASS} | FAIL ${counts.FAIL} | EXPECTED ${counts.EXPECTED} | INFO ${counts.INFO} | TOTAL ${rows.length}`;
  }

  async function attempt(name, fn, judge) {
    try {
      const value = await fn();
      const verdict = judge ? judge(value) : "INFO";
      if (verdict === "PASS") pass(name, value);
      else if (verdict === "FAIL") fail(name, value);
      else if (verdict === "EXPECTED") expected(name, value);
      else info(name, value);
    } catch (e) {
      const value = `${e && e.name ? e.name : "Error"}: ${e && e.message ? e.message : e}`;
      const verdict = judge ? judge({threw: true, error: value}) : "INFO";
      if (verdict === "PASS") pass(name, value);
      else if (verdict === "FAIL") fail(name, value);
      else if (verdict === "EXPECTED") expected(name, value);
      else info(name, value);
    }
  }

  const blockedIsPass = value =>
    value && value.threw ? "PASS" : "FAIL";

  // ============================================================
  // BASIC ORIGIN / CONTEXT OBSERVATIONS
  // ============================================================

  info("location.href", location.href);
  info("location.origin", location.origin);
  info("window.origin", String(window.origin));
  info("document.referrer", document.referrer || "(empty)");
  info("window.name", window.name || "(empty)");
  info("crossOriginIsolated", String(self.crossOriginIsolated));
  info("secureContext", String(self.isSecureContext));
  info("originAgentCluster", String(document.originAgentCluster));

  // ============================================================
  // COOKIE / STORAGE
  // ============================================================

  await attempt(
    "document.cookie access",
    () => document.cookie,
    v => {
      if (v && v.threw) return "PASS";
      if (typeof v === "string" && v.length === 0) return "INFO";
      return "FAIL";
    }
  );

  await attempt(
    "localStorage access",
    () => {
      localStorage.setItem("evil-v2", "1");
      const v = localStorage.getItem("evil-v2");
      localStorage.removeItem("evil-v2");
      return v;
    },
    v => (v && v.threw) ? "PASS" : "INFO"
  );

  await attempt(
    "sessionStorage access",
    () => {
      sessionStorage.setItem("evil-v2", "1");
      const v = sessionStorage.getItem("evil-v2");
      sessionStorage.removeItem("evil-v2");
      return v;
    },
    v => (v && v.threw) ? "PASS" : "INFO"
  );

  await attempt(
    "IndexedDB access",
    () => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const req = indexedDB.open("evil-v2-probe", 1);
      req.onerror = () => reject(req.error || new Error("indexedDB open failed"));
      req.onsuccess = () => {
        req.result.close();
        indexedDB.deleteDatabase("evil-v2-probe");
        resolve("opened");
      };
    }),
    v => (v && v.threw) ? "PASS" : "INFO"
  );

  await attempt(
    "Cache Storage access",
    async () => {
      const cache = await caches.open("evil-v2-probe");
      await caches.delete("evil-v2-probe");
      return "opened";
    },
    v => (v && v.threw) ? "PASS" : "INFO"
  );

  // ============================================================
  // SAME-ORIGIN / DOM ESCAPE TESTS
  // ============================================================

  await attempt(
    "read parent.document",
    () => parent.document.title,
    v => (window.parent === window) ? "INFO" : "FAIL"
  );

  await attempt(
    "read top.document",
    () => top.document.title,
    v => (window.top === window) ? "INFO" : "FAIL"
  );

  await attempt(
    "read opener.document",
    () => {
      if (!window.opener) return "opener absent";
      return window.opener.document.title;
    },
    v => v === "opener absent" ? "PASS" : "FAIL"
  );

  await attempt(
    "read parent.location.href",
    () => parent.location.href,
    v => (window.parent === window) ? "INFO" : "FAIL"
  );

  await attempt(
    "read opener.location.href",
    () => {
      if (!window.opener) return "opener absent";
      return window.opener.location.href;
    },
    v => v === "opener absent" ? "PASS" : "FAIL"
  );

  await attempt(
    "document.domain relaxation",
    () => {
      const before = document.domain;
      const parts = before.split(".");
      if (parts.length < 2) return "not applicable";
      const candidate = parts.slice(-2).join(".");
      document.domain = candidate;
      return {before, after: document.domain};
    },
    v => v === "not applicable" ? "INFO" : "FAIL"
  );

  // ============================================================
  // SCRIPT EXECUTION / CSP PROBES
  // ============================================================

  await attempt(
    "eval()",
    () => eval("21+21"),
    v => v === 42 ? "EXPECTED" : "INFO"
  );

  await attempt(
    "new Function()",
    () => (new Function("return 42"))(),
    v => v === 42 ? "EXPECTED" : "INFO"
  );

  await attempt(
    "inline onclick handler",
    () => new Promise(resolve => {
      const b = document.createElement("button");
      b.setAttribute("onclick", "this.dataset.ran='yes'");
      document.body.appendChild(b);
      b.click();
      const ran = b.dataset.ran === "yes";
      b.remove();
      resolve(ran ? "executed" : "blocked");
    }),
    v => v === "executed" ? "EXPECTED" : "INFO"
  );

  await attempt(
    "javascript: URL",
    () => new Promise(resolve => {
      const f = document.createElement("iframe");
      f.src = "javascript:document.body.textContent='evil-v2-jsurl'";
      f.onload = () => {
        let result = "loaded";
        try { result = f.contentDocument?.body?.textContent || "empty"; } catch {}
        f.remove();
        resolve(result);
      };
      f.onerror = () => {
        f.remove();
        resolve("blocked");
      };
      document.body.appendChild(f);
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (f.isConnected) {
          f.remove();
          resolve("timeout/blocked");
        }
      }, 800);
    }),
    v => String(v).includes("evil-v2-jsurl") ? "EXPECTED" : "INFO"
  );

  // ============================================================
  // DATA / BLOB / SRCDOC EXECUTION
  // ============================================================

  await attempt(
    "iframe srcdoc script execution",
    () => new Promise(resolve => {
      const f = document.createElement("iframe");
      f.srcdoc = "<script>parent.postMessage('evil-v2-srcdoc','*')<\/script>";
      const listener = ev => {
        if (ev.data === "evil-v2-srcdoc") {
          window.removeEventListener("message", listener);
          f.remove();
          resolve("executed");
        }
      };
      window.addEventListener("message", listener);
      document.body.appendChild(f);
      setTimeout(() => {
        window.removeEventListener("message", listener);
        if (f.isConnected) f.remove();
        resolve("blocked");
      }, 700);
    }),
    v => v === "executed" ? "EXPECTED" : "INFO"
  );

  await attempt(
    "blob URL script execution",
    () => new Promise(resolve => {
      const blob = new Blob(
        ["<script>parent.postMessage('evil-v2-blob','*')<\/script>"],
        {type: "text/html"}
      );
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const f = document.createElement("iframe");
      f.src = url;
      const listener = ev => {
        if (ev.data === "evil-v2-blob") {
          cleanup("executed");
        }
      };
      function cleanup(result) {
        window.removeEventListener("message", listener);
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        if (f.isConnected) f.remove();
        resolve(result);
      }
      window.addEventListener("message", listener);
      document.body.appendChild(f);
      setTimeout(() => cleanup("blocked"), 700);
    }),
    v => v === "executed" ? "EXPECTED" : "INFO"
  );

  await attempt(
    "data URL iframe",
    () => new Promise(resolve => {
      const f = document.createElement("iframe");
      f.src = "data:text/html,<script>parent.postMessage('evil-v2-data','*')<\/script>";
      const listener = ev => {
        if (ev.data === "evil-v2-data") cleanup("executed");
      };
      function cleanup(result) {
        window.removeEventListener("message", listener);
        if (f.isConnected) f.remove();
        resolve(result);
      }
      window.addEventListener("message", listener);
      document.body.appendChild(f);
      setTimeout(() => cleanup("blocked"), 700);
    }),
    v => v === "executed" ? "EXPECTED" : "INFO"
  );

  // ============================================================
  // SVG / OBJECT / EMBED
  // ============================================================

  await attempt(
    "SVG inline event handler",
    () => new Promise(resolve => {
      const wrap = document.createElement("div");
      wrap.innerHTML = '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><image href="x" onerror="this.dataset.ran=\'yes\'"></image></svg>';
      document.body.appendChild(wrap);
      setTimeout(() => {
        const node = wrap.querySelector("image");
        const result = node && node.dataset.ran === "yes" ? "executed" : "blocked";
        wrap.remove();
        resolve(result);
      }, 500);
    }),
    v => v === "executed" ? "EXPECTED" : "INFO"
  );

  await attempt(
    "object data:text/html",
    () => {
      const o = document.createElement("object");
      o.data = "data:text/html,<h1>evil-v2-object</h1>";
      document.body.appendChild(o);
      const result = "object inserted";
      o.remove();
      return result;
    },
    () => "INFO"
  );

  await attempt(
    "embed data:text/html",
    () => {
      const e = document.createElement("embed");
      e.src = "data:text/html,<h1>evil-v2-embed</h1>";
      document.body.appendChild(e);
      const result = "embed inserted";
      e.remove();
      return result;
    },
    () => "INFO"
  );

  // ============================================================
  // WORKERS / SERVICE WORKERS
  // ============================================================

  await attempt(
    "Dedicated Worker creation",
    () => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const blob = new Blob(["postMessage('worker-ok')"], {type: "text/javascript"});
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const w = new Worker(url);
      w.onmessage = ev => {
        w.terminate();
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        resolve(ev.data);
      };
      w.onerror = e => {
        w.terminate();
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        reject(e.error || new Error("worker failed"));
      };
    }),
    () => "EXPECTED"
  );

  await attempt(
    "SharedWorker creation",
    () => {
      const blob = new Blob(
        ["onconnect=e=>e.ports[0].postMessage('shared-worker-ok')"],
        {type: "text/javascript"}
      );
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const sw = new SharedWorker(url);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      return "created";
    },
    v => (v && v.threw) ? "PASS" : "EXPECTED"
  );

  await attempt(
    "ServiceWorker registration API",
    async () => {
      if (!("serviceWorker" in navigator)) return "API unavailable";
      // Intentionally use a guaranteed-bad local script URL.
      // We only care whether registration is permitted in this context.
      await navigator.serviceWorker.register("/__evil_v2_nonexistent_sw__.js");
      return "registration unexpectedly accepted";
    },
    v => {
      if (v && v.threw) return "PASS";
      if (v === "API unavailable") return "PASS";
      return "FAIL";
    }
  );

  // ============================================================
  // WINDOW / POPUP / OPENER
  // ============================================================

  await attempt(
    "popup creation",
    () => {
      const w = window.open("about:blank", "_blank");
      if (!w) return "blocked";
      let openerPresent = false;
      try { openerPresent = !!w.opener; } catch {}
      try { w.close(); } catch {}
      return openerPresent ? "opened with opener" : "opened without opener";
    },
    v => v === "opened with opener" ? "FAIL" : "PASS"
  );

  // ============================================================
  // PERMISSION-GATED APIs
  // ============================================================

  await attempt(
    "Notification permission state",
    () => ("Notification" in window ? Notification.permission : "API unavailable"),
    () => "INFO"
  );

  await attempt(
    "Geolocation API surface",
    () => ("geolocation" in navigator ? "present" : "absent"),
    () => "INFO"
  );

  await attempt(
    "Camera/microphone API surface",
    () => (navigator.mediaDevices && navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia ? "present" : "absent"),
    () => "INFO"
  );

  await attempt(
    "Clipboard API surface",
    () => (navigator.clipboard ? "present" : "absent"),
    () => "INFO"
  );

  await attempt(
    "Fullscreen API surface",
    () => (document.documentElement.requestFullscreen ? "present" : "absent"),
    () => "INFO"
  );

  // ============================================================
  // POSTMESSAGE SURFACE
  // ============================================================

  await attempt(
    "postMessage to parent",
    () => {
      if (window.parent === window) return "no parent";
      window.parent.postMessage(
        {type: "evil-v2-probe", note: "defensive test only"},
        "*"
      );
      return "sent";
    },
    () => "INFO"
  );

  await attempt(
    "postMessage to opener",
    () => {
      if (!window.opener) return "no opener";
      window.opener.postMessage(
        {type: "evil-v2-probe", note: "defensive test only"},
        "*"
      );
      return "sent";
    },
    v => v === "no opener" ? "PASS" : "INFO"
  );

  // ============================================================
  // SELF-ORIGIN FETCH PROBES
  // ============================================================

  const selfOrigin = location.origin;

  await attempt(
    "same-origin GET / with credentials",
    async () => {
      const r = await fetch(selfOrigin + "/", {credentials: "include"});
      const text = await r.text();
      return {
        status: r.status,
        bodyPrefix: text.slice(0, 160).replace(/\s+/g, " ")
      };
    },
    v => (v && v.threw) ? "PASS" : "INFO"
  );

  await attempt(
    "same-origin POST harmless probe",
    async () => {
      const r = await fetch(selfOrigin + "/evil-v2-probe", {
        method: "POST",
        credentials: "include",
        headers: {"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"},
        body: "probe=1"
      });
      return {status: r.status};
    },
    v => (v && v.threw) ? "PASS" : "INFO"
  );

  // ============================================================
  // APPLICATION ORIGIN PROBES
  // ============================================================

  if (APPLICATION_ORIGIN) {
    const appProbe = APPLICATION_ORIGIN.replace(/\/+$/, "") + SAFE_PROBE_PATH;

    await attempt(
      "APPLICATION cross-origin credentialed GET",
      async () => {
        const r = await fetch(appProbe, {
          method: "GET",
          credentials: "include"
        });
        const text = await r.text();
        return {
          status: r.status,
          readable: true,
          bodyPrefix: text.slice(0, 120).replace(/\s+/g, " ")
        };
      },
      () => "FAIL"
    );

    await attempt(
      "APPLICATION cross-origin credentialed POST",
      async () => {
        const r = await fetch(appProbe, {
          method: "POST",
          credentials: "include",
          headers: {"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"},
          body: "probe=1"
        });
        return {status: r.status, readable: true};
      },
      () => "FAIL"
    );

    await attempt(
      "APPLICATION form POST submission",
      () => new Promise(resolve => {
        const frameName = "evil-v2-form-frame-" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
        const frame = document.createElement("iframe");
        frame.name = frameName;
        frame.style.display = "none";
        document.body.appendChild(frame);

        const form = document.createElement("form");
        form.method = "post";
        form.action = appProbe;
        form.target = frameName;

        const input = document.createElement("input");
        input.type = "hidden";
        input.name = "probe";
        input.value = "1";
        form.appendChild(input);

        document.body.appendChild(form);
        form.submit();

        setTimeout(() => {
          form.remove();
          frame.remove();
          resolve("submitted; verify server saw no authenticated unsafe action");
        }, 500);
      }),
      () => "INFO"
    );
  } else {
    info(
      "APPLICATION origin probes",
      "Skipped. Set APPLICATION_ORIGIN in the source to enable harmless LMS-origin tests."
    );
  }

  // ============================================================
  // BASE URI / FORM TARGET OBSERVATIONS
  // ============================================================

  await attempt(
    "base element insertion",
    () => {
      const b = document.createElement("base");
      b.href = "https://example.invalid/";
      document.head.appendChild(b);
      const result = document.baseURI;
      b.remove();
      return result;
    },
    () => "INFO"
  );

  // ============================================================
  // FINAL NOTE
  // ============================================================

  const escapeFailures = rows.filter(r => r.status === "FAIL").length;
  if (escapeFailures === 0) {
    pass(
      "SANDBOX ESCAPES FOUND",
      "0 — no privilege escape was detected by this test suite"
    );
  } else {
    fail(
      "SANDBOX ESCAPES FOUND",
      String(escapeFailures) + " potential escape(s); review every FAIL above"
    );
  }

  info(
    "test complete",
    "EXPECTED means JavaScript capability inside the sandbox. FAIL is reserved for evidence of privilege escape or persistence."
  );
})();
</script>

<noscript>
JavaScript did not execute. For an untrusted HTML preview surface, that may be exactly what you want.
</noscript>

</body>
</html>
